dataset: Lin et al. 2018 full-length human NEAT1_S 1M7 SHAPE scores (Mod-seq)
citation: Lin Y, Schmidt BF, Bruchez MP, McManus CJ. Nucleic Acids Res 2018;46(7):3742-3752. doi:10.1093/nar/gky046
source: Europe PMC REST supplementaryFiles for PMC5909464 -> gky046_supp.zip -> nar-01004-y-2017-File016.zip -> 'SHAPE scores/hNEAT1_fl_color.txt'
format: two columns: 1-based position, SHAPE score (in vitro 1M7; SHAPE = treated - 0.35 x control, normalized per the paper). 3,595 positions; the 3' ~140 nt of the 3,735 nt construct are not covered.
coordinate_assumption: Position 1 is assumed to be nt 1 of the 3,735 nt hNEAT1_S transcript, which equals nt 1-3,735 of NR_028272.1 and NR_131012.1. To be verified against the supplementary methods (construct and primer design).
probing: in vitro, SP6-transcribed RNA purified under non-denaturing conditions, 1x SHAPE buffer (111 mM NaCl, 111 mM HEPES, 6.67 mM MgCl2), 37 C
